title: notocactus mammulosus
intro: Notocactus mammulosus, commonly known as the hairy ball cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Notocactus. It is a small, globular cactus with short, fine, and hairy stems, typically growing up to 5-7 cm in diameter. The health benefits of Notocactus mammulosus include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to wound healing and the protection against infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antiproliferative, and immunomodulatory activities.
